newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down 10 cents to 14.80 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down 10 cents to 14.80 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell 10 cents to 14.80 ringgit ($5.91) a kg in reaction to a sharp overnight fall on the London Metal Exchange (LME).
"The market just followed through with the LME fall," said a dealer. "I suppose it will now track the strength of the LME before trying to climb back to the old support level of 15 ringgit (a kg)."
Turnover fell to 67 tonnes from 50 on Monday. Bids totalled 42 tonnes against offers of 80. Buyers were from Europe and Malaysia. The premium against London rose to $100 from $55.
